name: rfc2217-client-serial
description: Connect the BBC serial port (RS423) to a remote RFC 2217 access server over TCP

parameters.description: Access-server endpoint as [scheme://]host:port (e.g. url="rfc2217://ser2net.local:4001"); alternative to host/port, cannot be combined with them
RFC 2217 access-server hostname or address (alternative to url)
RFC 2217 access-server TCP port (alternative to url)
baud rate to set on the remote UART (real hardware)
transmit buffer size in bytes; the BBC's /CTS asserts at/above it
